[P2] Approach: preserve the existing data-retention capability

Rule 1.3 (“Keep it simple”) permits capability-losing simplifications for new features; removing an existing capability follows the breaking-change release rules. This search assumes a monotonic size predicate despite supported records violating it. With one large oldest result followed by many `true` results, clearing only the oldest result can fit, but this search can skip that fitting prefix, clear every result, and drop whole operations. Consumers consequently lose operation history that the current implementation retains. Documenting this as a performance trade-off does not preserve compatibility. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6, as required by rule 9) and choose an optimization that preserves existing retention, or explicitly handle the capability removal through the breaking-change design and release process.
